facts.name: Fernwick Tea Co.
facts.story: We blend loose-leaf teas from two family gardens and ship them in reusable tins
facts.scale: Twelve blends, sold in 30 independent cafes
facts.claim: Every blend is named for the hour it is best drunk
facts.notice: The autumn blend, Dusk No. 4, is back this week
facts.news: 2026-09-10 Dusk No. 4 is back for autumn https://example.com/news/dusk-no-4 ; 2026-06-02 Our tins now ship to 30 independent cafes https://example.com/news/ship-to-30-cafes ; 2026-03-15 A second family garden joins the harvest https://example.com/news/second-garden
facts.history: 2021 Founded with one blend from one garden ; 2023 Added a second family garden ; 2025 Twelve blends now sit in 30 independent cafes
facts.leaders: Amara Ellis | Founder and CEO | Blends every tea herself and visits both gardens each season ; Jun Park | Head of Sourcing | Works with the two family gardens all year
facts.audience: Independent cafe owners and home tea drinkers who like small-batch loose-leaf tea
facts.action: Order a tasting set or ask about stocking our tins
